clauses.reason: The order exempts Arthur S. Flemming, Commissioner on Aging, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, and Chairman of the Commission on Civil Rights, from mandatory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5 of the United States Code until June 30, 1978. The order recites his earlier exemptions until June 30, 1976 (Executive Order No. 11869) and until June 30, 1977 (Executive Order No. 11924), earlier orders that are not later events for this order. The order is a single command with one fixed term, so its own stated date is the first end: 1978-06-30, recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is 1978-06-29. The order was signed 1977-06-29. No amendment, revocation or shortening of this order is held (searched below).

research_rationale:
EO 12000 (signed 1977-06-29) is a one-person exemption under section 8335(c) of title 5, United States Code: Arthur S. Flemming, Commissioner on Aging, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, and Chairman of the Commission on Civil Rights, is exempted from mandatory retirement for age until June 30, 1978. The held Federal Register text of the order was read in full and is a single operative clause (the recital, the finding of public interest, and the exempting sentence). The order ends by its own terms on 1978-06-30 (inclusive; exclusive alternative 1978-06-29, owner ruling 2026-10-21 on until dates). Searches judged adequate: U.S. Code and eCFR (no hit naming the order), the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note catalog, and the held-text search for the person's full name, which found the chain members recorded above and nothing else. Whether the person left office on or before the stated date is not in any held source and is not asserted.

savings.reason: The exemption only suspended compulsory retirement for the stated term; it creates no continuing duty, office or rule. The person's service during the term and the pay for it had accrued by 1978-06-30; nothing in the order survives that date, and any later exemption is a separate grant recorded as a later event.
